route: performance A/B: boot -> profile -> Land3 (tr3 boot feed at 450 s) -> land load (600-900 s) -> Land3 intro cinema (heavy in-world scene, ~600 draws/present, from ~1000-1200 s). Fixed-work metric: render-worker CPU per completed draw over the same probe-time windows, arms run as concurrent pairs on one boat.
command: scripts/arm.sh TREE RUN SECONDS (= node tools/black-white-software-probe.js --seconds=N --skip-intro --no-build --capture-every=300 --control-stdin < RUN/ctl.fifo, tr3 boot feed at 450 s, plus scripts/threadcpu.js per-thread /proc CPU every 30 s); PROF=1 passes --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-interval=4000 to the CLI child through scripts/patch-probe.js (boat-only probe edit, both arms); NODE=<v24 binary> picks the Node version. Windows: scripts/abstat.js; profiles: scripts/profsum.js.

summary: f5329feb1 (render worker gets its own lock identity) costs no measurable frame rate. Render-worker CPU per draw, parent vs fix, same boat, same Node v20, concurrent pairs: land load 600-900 s 126.45 vs 125.98 ms (rep 1), 100.54 vs 99.35 ms (rep 2, both profiled), 108.35 vs 105.34 ms (rep 4); heavy Land3 intro 900-1200 s 14.51 vs 14.12 ms and 1200-1500 s 11.93 vs 12.01 ms (75.87 vs 75.39 draws/s, 0.140 vs 0.136 fps; rep 2, the only rep in which the parent survived that far). V8 CPU profiles of the render worker: $lock_acquire is 0.01% inclusive in both arms (0.03 s of 300 s), $lock_release <0.01%, $w2g_sparse 0.16%. The parent arm hit the old -1 raster latch in 2 of 3 unprofiled runs (first failure ~1125 s in rep 1, ~900-1200 s in rep 4), so the heavy scene has one parent sample. Node v24.18.1 vs v20.20.2 on the fix build (rep 3): ~10-15% less worker CPU per draw in the heavy scene (12.25/12.72 vs 13.73/14.56 ms) and a faster land load, so Node accounts for part of the 0.146 vs 0.09 fps gap between the Oct 23 runs; the rest is scene and host/load (two runs shared 4 vCPUs here). Where the worker's time goes in the heavy scene (both arms alike): $heap_alloc 23.5% inclusive, almost all from $d3d_software_create_mode allocating each draw's ~852 KB context as a fresh large arena: $heap_large_alloc -> $virtual_reserve_down -> $virtual_reserve_place -> $virtual_range_edge_locked 13.3%, and $heap_arena_register -> $heap_arena_release_free -> $heap_free_list_purge -> $heap_arena_find 7%; $heap_free 7.7%; $heap_arena_find is the top self-time function at 17.5%. That is an optimization lead independent of f5329feb1.
